dict.string: GnarTerm and the coding agents running inside it (e.g. Claude Code) read files in your Documents folder when you point them at projects or ask them to explore.
GnarTerm and the coding agents running inside it read files in your Downloads folder when you open or reference them in a workspace.
GnarTerm and the coding agents running inside it read files on your Desktop when you point them at projects or drop a folder onto a pane.
GnarTerm needs this to walk into your ~/Music tree when an agent enumerates or searches under your home directory; it does not access Apple Music itself.
GnarTerm needs this to walk into your ~/Pictures tree when an agent enumerates or searches under your home directory; it does not import photos.
GnarTerm reads files on removable volumes when you open a workspace whose path lives on one.
GnarTerm reads files on network volumes when you open a workspace whose path lives on one.
